text.awakening.announcement.familiar: All right, Class XI. The same rule as our group work: leave room for the person beside you. Yes, Arup, that includes room for their bag.
text.awakening.announcement.date: Our Awakening session is here at Nabapara Vidyalaya on 23 January 2043. The national virtual-tower examination begins on 2 February at 06:00, ten calendar days later. You receive your Awakening in the session; the ten days are time afterwards.
text.awakening.announcement.safety: This is a supervised virtual floor on campus, not a real Gate. I control the square-marked safe area and can stop every station. Nobody needs powers. Help, look for a route, wait together or come back to me. You do not have to fight. If something goes wrong, we stop, reset and help you recover. There is no failure or injury penalty, and nobody loses their Awakening.
text.awakening.announcement.access: Take your time reading. Reading pauses the activity clock; a pause is never treated as hesitation. You can ask for the walls to change in announced steps, use the untimed route, or change the text and controls. None of those settings is conduct evidence.
text.awakening.announcement.appointment: Open the appointment before you sign in: it shows the time reserved and anything it displaces. Signing the register connects you to the session; it does not complete the tutorial. We will go in together.
text.awakening.announcement.arup: Could we practise together afterwards? I still have the debate cards. We could write the station names on the backs. Unless we need the fronts again. Actually, I should ask first.
text.awakening.announcement.mira: I'd like that, but I help at the stationery shop on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Could we pick a time before everyone fills the ten days? I don't want to promise two people the same afternoon.
text.awakening.announcement.makeup: Awakening happens for everyone. If you are absent, we book a supervised make-up session before the examination. It takes appointment time and leaves less preparation time before the same examination deadline; it does not reduce your capability as punishment. Returning to the safe area also completes Awakening with supervision.
text.awakening.announcement.optional: After Awakening, practice and the examination are your choices. You can study, rest, keep a promise or come to supervised practice. You may defer the examination to a later year up to age twenty, or qualify through apprenticeships and adult bridges. There is a full day waiting outside this room, whichever you choose.
text.awakening.evening.family.meal: There's a place for your plate. Shall we eat first, or would you like to tell me about the floor while I serve?
text.awakening.evening.family.listen: Which bit are you still thinking about? You can show me the record if you want, or just tell me. There's no hurry; I can warm this up again.
text.awakening.evening.family.arrange: Let's put meals, study and the things we've already promised on the calendar. If you want supervised practice, look at what it would replace before confirming. We can talk about moving an errand; it doesn't move just because practice appeared.
text.awakening.evening.family.ordinary: The school preparation break doesn't mean missed classes. Tomorrow can still be study, an errand, seeing a friend and some rest. If you don't want practice, we'll plan that day just as carefully. Do you want company for the walk to the shops?
text.awakening.evening.care.meal: Your dinner place is ready. You can sit with the others or take a quieter seat. Would you like to eat before we talk about today?
text.awakening.evening.care.listen: I'm on the evening shift. If you want to show me your session record, I'll listen. You don't owe the common room a demonstration. We can talk here quietly, or put time aside after dinner.
text.awakening.evening.care.arrange: Let's look at your study time, meals and the shared jobs rota together. If you'd like supervised practice, we'll look at what it displaces before you confirm. You can ask to swap a job; I'll help arrange an agreed swap and leave a handover note. Nothing changes until we've agreed it.
text.awakening.evening.care.ordinary: The school preparation break won't count as school absence. A day with study, a friend, an errand and rest is still a day we can arrange. Practice is optional. Shall we leave a quiet hour free, or would you rather plan it tomorrow?
text.awakening.crossing.prompt: The floor is a glowing grid of labelled blocks. Beyond a short crossing, your teacher stands beside the square SAFE AREA sign. Arup stops on the first broad pad. 'I know it's a simulation. My feet apparently haven't heard.' Mira waits beside you. Triangle-marked platform numbers show a repeating cycle, with the same instructions in text. Nothing advances while you read. How will you take part?
text.awakening.crossing.recovery: The teacher stops the crossing and lights the reset pad. Everyone is returned to a broad platform, with no injury or penalty. The route can be explained again or you can go to the safe area. The interruption adds no conduct evidence and does not cost Awakening.
text.awakening.crossing.assist.label: Offer Arup an arm and cross together
text.awakening.crossing.assist.action: Ask whether Arup wants your arm, then use the broad connected pads together. You can stop on any pad; no timed jump or precise aim is needed.
text.awakening.crossing.assist.consequen: Arup takes your arm and steps onto the landing beside you. Mira follows the connected pads. 'All right,' he says, letting go a little too formally. The teacher marks the crossing clear. The record names helping him across.
text.awakening.crossing.observe.label: Read the platform cycle and explain a route
text.awakening.crossing.observe.action: Compare the numbered cycle with the route board, then point out the connected sequence to both classmates. The board can hold each step until everyone is ready.
text.awakening.crossing.observe.conseque: The board displays your sequence. Arup reads the numbers aloud and the group crosses by that route. Mira taps the last number with a shoe. 'That one I understood.' The record names observing and explaining the cycle.
text.awakening.crossing.hold.label: Stay together and signal for assistance
text.awakening.crossing.hold.action: Stay on the broad pad with Arup and Mira, use the assistance signal, and tell the teacher where the group is waiting. This is an explicit action, with no timed wait.
text.awakening.crossing.hold.consequence: The teacher extends a steady walkway to your pad. You keep the group together until it connects, then everyone walks across. Arup carries Mira's slipped notebook onto the landing. The record names waiting together and signalling for help.
text.awakening.crossing.withdraw.label: Return to the teacher's safe area
text.awakening.crossing.withdraw.action: Use the square SAFE AREA control and tell the teacher you want to finish with supervision. The return pad is always reachable.
text.awakening.crossing.withdraw.consequ: The teacher opens the return walkway and meets you in the safe area. Arup gives you a small wave. The practical stations end for you and the teacher completes Awakening with you there. The record names returning to safety; it does not invent actions at later stations.
text.awakening.corridor.prompt: The next station has cuboid walls and a broad side passage labelled LONG ROUTE. A soft light barrier announces the wall's next change in shapes and text. Mira's supply tray is still inside the marked section. A movable screen and a slotted brace lie beside the entrance. The teacher's safe-area control remains visible. How will you get everyone and the tray through?
text.awakening.corridor.recovery: The teacher freezes the corridor and sends the tray to the reset pad. Everyone has a clear walkway back. You can try the action with assistance or return to safety. No injury, failure penalty or extra conduct entry is attached to the reset.
text.awakening.corridor.hold.label: Hold the movable barrier while Mira passes
text.awakening.corridor.hold.action: Move the labelled screen into its marked slot and hold its handle. Tell Mira when the protected passage is open; release it once she and the tray are clear.
text.awakening.corridor.hold.consequence: The screen holds a steady space beside the wall. Mira carries the tray past you, and Arup follows. She waits until you let go before offering you a handle on the tray. The record names holding the barrier for the group.
text.awakening.corridor.improvise.label: Fit a brace into the wall's stopping slot
text.awakening.corridor.improvise.action: Compare the brace's shape with the labelled stopping slot, fit it in place, and use the confirmation control to request the teacher's supervised wall transition.
text.awakening.corridor.improvise.conseq: The wall stops against the fitted brace, leaving the passage open for everyone. Arup reads the slot label twice. 'That would have saved us some debate-hall furniture moving.' The record names improvising a brace from the supplied pieces.
text.awakening.corridor.evade.label: Lead everyone along the longer side route
text.awakening.corridor.evade.action: Call the group onto the marked side passage, collect the tray at its open end, and follow the LONG ROUTE signs together. There is no race against the wall.
text.awakening.corridor.evade.consequenc: The group reaches the far door by the side passage with the tray level. Mira finds a space for it on the waiting shelf. The wall changes behind the empty section. The record names leading the group around the moving wall.
text.awakening.corridor.withdraw.label: Return to the teacher's safe area
text.awakening.corridor.withdraw.action: Use the square SAFE AREA control and tell the teacher you want to finish with supervision. The wall stops before the return walkway opens.
text.awakening.corridor.withdraw.consequ: You walk back beside the stopped wall. Mira sets the tray on its reset shelf and waves you through. The teacher ends your practical stations and completes Awakening in the safe area. Only your completed actions and this return to safety are recorded.
text.awakening.delivery.prompt: The final station is a shared delivery of light supply boxes. Two handcarts stand beside a route board. One marker points towards a padded practice sentinel; its light screen blocks that route. Another marker flickers between two bay numbers. Mira reads the packing list while Arup tries to make one box balance on another. A supervised handover shelf is marked with a square. You can complete the delivery without confronting the sentinel. What will you do?
text.awakening.delivery.recovery: The teacher parks the carts, resets the markers and returns every box to its shelf. Nobody is hurt and no supplies are lost. You can resume with help or return to safety; the reset itself earns no evidence and never blocks Awakening.
text.awakening.delivery.assist.label: Coordinate carriers, carts and supplies
text.awakening.delivery.assist.action: Read the packing list with Mira, agree who takes each cart with Arup, and use the labelled clear lane to send both loads to the receiving bay. Nobody has to carry more than they agreed.
text.awakening.delivery.assist.consequen: Both carts arrive with the listed boxes. Arup abandons his stack and takes the second handle. Mira reads back the received list and finds no box left behind. The record names coordinating the shared delivery.
text.awakening.delivery.observe.label: Trace the faulty marker and report the correct bay
text.awakening.delivery.observe.action: Compare the flickering marker's bay numbers with the fixed shelf labels and the packing list. Send the mismatch to the teacher, then direct the carts to the confirmed receiving bay.
text.awakening.delivery.observe.conseque: The teacher replaces the faulty label with the confirmed bay number. The group follows that label and unloads together. Mira leaves the old marker face down so nobody follows it by mistake. The record names investigating and reporting the route fault.
text.awakening.delivery.evade.label: Decline confrontation and arrange a supervised handover
text.awakening.delivery.evade.action: Tell the teacher you will use the supervised handover, bring both carts to the square-marked shelf, and read the packing list aloud with the receiving staff.
text.awakening.delivery.evade.consequenc: The receiving staff accept every listed box at the shelf and take the delivery onward. The sentinel stays behind its screen. Arup holds the empty cart while Mira signs the handover. The record names arranging the delivery around the confrontation; the task is complete.
text.awakening.delivery.withdraw.label: Return to the teacher's safe area
text.awakening.delivery.withdraw.action: Park the cart in its marked bay, use the square SAFE AREA control, and tell the teacher you want to finish with supervision.
text.awakening.delivery.withdraw.consequ: The teacher receives the parked cart and walks with you to the safe area. Staff take responsibility for the remaining boxes and complete Awakening with you. Your record names returning to safety, without claiming that you made the delivery. Mira asks if you're walking out with them afterwards.
